versions.changelog:
- Initial release of geekbi-shopee-product-search-skill.
- Enables Shopee product search and analysis using 极鲸云 data, covering sales, price, rating, reviews, likes, stock, cross-border attributes, listing time, and trends.
- Strictly uses data returned by 极鲸云 interfaces; explains boundaries (no keyword trends, comment content, ads, profit, or Seller Centre actions).
- Outputs always specify filters, site, sample size, currency, and data update time.
- Provides clear workflow and interface usage principles for business users.
